meta.note: Coverage of Figma variants by CSS selectors, read from css/components/*.css and css/site/*.css (the sources of the generated css/hope.css). "rule" is the literal CSS selector that implements the variant; scripts/check-docs.mjs fails if a rule or class is missing from css/*.css. Counts are computed from this file and must match components-code-notes.json.

stateMechanisms.focus: Pseudo-class .btn:focus-visible: outline var(--focus-ring-width) solid var(--color-border-focus-ring) with offset var(--focus-ring-gap), one rule shared by every style. No state class.
stateMechanisms.disabled: .btn.btn:disabled and .btn.btn[aria-disabled="true"] (specificity 0,3,0, so it also beats :hover). Secondary, Ghost and Small Ghost have their own disabled rules (no fill). Background, text and border use the disabled tokens. No state class.

stateMechanisms.hover: pseudo-class .link:hover: weight 700, colour unchanged (the global a:hover colour is overridden by .link:hover)
stateMechanisms.focus: .link:focus-visible: weight 700 and a square 2px outline with 2px offset (--focus-ring-width, --focus-ring-gap)
stateMechanisms.disabled: .link[aria-disabled="true"]: --color-text-disabled-default, weight 400, not focusable when the anchor has no href

Link.globalRulesDescription: Anchors without .link are still styled by the global a rules (css/reset.css): brand colour, no underline, a hover colour and a 2px outline on focus. The .link class overrides them for Link.

Separator.note: Decorative horizontal rule: <hr class="separator" aria-hidden="true">. No vertical variant exists in Figma and none was created.

Banner.note: The Hope .banner is the Figma Notice. The site keeps a legacy .banner--wip modifier (case-studies/sb-home-redesign.html) so the page does not change.

variants.mechanism: state class .is-open set by js/lightbox.js; hidden attribute hides it

Lightbox.note: CSS in css/components/lightbox.css, aligned to Figma in v2.13.0 and v2.13.1. It is a fixed full-screen viewer built and driven by js/lightbox.js (with js/overlay.js), so it is demonstrated on its own page from an image and not rendered on the review page. The close button is the Lightbox close component (key LightboxClose).
